text.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，石墨纯度优于5 ppm硼当量，依据ASTM C1233-98确定。适用该标准时，元素碳的硼当量不计入硼当量计算，因为碳不被视为杂质。就本条目而言，‘氘’是指氘原子与氢原子之比超过1:5,000的氘及任何氘化合物，包括重水。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, graphite with a purity level better than 5 parts per million boron equivalent is determined according to ASTM standard C1233-98. In applying ASTM standard C1233-98, the boron equivalence of the element carbon is not included in the boron equivalence calculation, since carbon is not considered an impurity. For the purpose of this entry, 'Deuterium' means deuterium and any deuterium compound, including heavy water, in which the ratio of deuterium atoms to hydrogen atoms exceeds 1:5000.

text.zh: CW适用于1C350.b和.c。商业国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向《禁止化学武器公约》（CWC）非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C350.b所列附表2化学品和混合物，因CW原因须取得许可证。向CWC非缔约国出口1C350.c所列附表3化学品和混合物，因CW原因须取得许可证，除非出口商在出口前已取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明。将1C350.c所列附表3化学品和混合物从一个CWC非缔约国再出口至任何其他CWC非缔约国，因CW原因须取得许可证。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR §742.18。向EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明国家出口附表3化学品适用的最终用途证明要求，见EAR §745.2。）
text.en: CW applies to 1C350.b and .c. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required, for CW reasons, to export or reexport Schedule 2 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.b to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR). A license is required, for CW reasons, to export Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.c to States not Party to the CWC, unless an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country has been obtained by the exporter prior to export. A license is required, for CW reasons, to reexport Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.c from a State not Party to the CWC to any other State not Party to the CWC. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons. See § 745.2 of the EAR for End-Use Certificate requirements that apply to exports of Schedule 3 chemicals to countries not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR.)

text.zh: AT适用于本条目全部物项。商业国家表不用于确定1C350中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C350管制物项，因AT原因须取得许可证。（有关适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的AT管制，见EAR第742部分；适用于这些国家的制裁，见EAR第746部分。）
text.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C350. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C350 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

text.zh: 1. 样品运输：在符合以下要求和限制的前提下，同一历年向同一收货人运输单一化学品样品的累计总量不超过一个55加仑容器或200千克时，无须许可证。依据本项排除接收样品的收货人不得转售、转移或再出口样品，但可将其用于与化学武器无关的任何其他合法目的。
text.en: 1. SAMPLE SHIPMENTS: Subject to the following requirements and restrictions, a license is not required for sample shipments when the cumulative total of these shipments does not exceed a 55-gallon container or 200 kg of a single chemical to any one consignee during a calendar year. A consignee that receives a sample shipment under this exclusion may not resell, transfer, or reexport the sample shipment, but may use the sample shipment for any other legal purpose unrelated to chemical weapons.

text.zh: a. 不符合资格的化学品
B. CWC附表2化学品（CWC非缔约国）。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）运输1C350.b所列任何CWC附表2化学品或混合物的样品，均不得免证。
text.en: B. CWC Schedule 2 chemicals (States not Party to the CWC). No CWC Schedule 2 chemical or mixture identified in 1C350.b is eligible for sample shipment to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR) without a license.

text.zh: b. 不符合资格的国家：EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家，不得无证接收本ECCN管制的任何化学品样品。
text.en: b. Countries Not Eligible: Countries in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR are not eligible to receive sample shipments of any chemicals controlled by this ECCN without a license.

text.zh: c. 因CW原因须取得最终用途证明的样品运输：向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）运输1C350.c所列任何CWC附表3化学品或混合物的样品，均不得免证，除非出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明（最终用途证明要求见EAR §745.2）。
text.en: c. Sample shipments that require an End-Use Certificate for CW reasons: No CWC Schedule 3 chemical or mixture identified in 1C350.c is eligible for sample shipment to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR) without a license, unless an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter prior to export (see § 745.2 of the EAR for End-Use Certificate requirements).

text.zh: d. 因EAR其他规定须取得许可证的样品运输：本注1所述样品运输，仍可能因EAR其他规定须取得许可证。尤其参见EAR第744部分最终用途/最终用户限制，以及第746部分对禁运国家的限制。
text.en: d. Sample shipments that require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR: Sample shipments, as described in this Note 1, may require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR. See, in particular, the end-use/end-user restrictions in part 744 of the EAR, and the restrictions that apply to embargoed countries in part 746 of the EAR.

text.zh: e. 年度报告要求。出口商须就依据本注1进行的样品运输提交年度书面报告。报告须使用公司抬头信纸，第一页顶部标题为“Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors”（化学品前体样品运输报告），并列明上一历年全部样品运输的化学品名称、化学文摘社登记号（CAS号）、数量、最终收货人姓名或名称及地址，以及出口日期。报告须最迟于样品运输所在历年次年2月28日提交至：U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, 14th Street and Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Room 2099B, Washington, DC 20230；收件事项：“Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors”。
text.en: e. Annual report requirement. The exporter is required to submit an annual written report for shipments of samples made under this Note 1. The report must be on company letterhead stationery (titled “Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors” at the top of the first page) and identify the chemical(s), Chemical Abstract Service Registry (C.A.S.) number(s), quantity(ies), the ultimate consignee's name and address, and the date of export for all sample shipments that were made during the previous calendar year. The report must be submitted no later than February 28 of the year following the calendar year in which the sample shipments were made, to: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, 14th Street and Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Room 2099B, Washington, DC 20230, Attn: “Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors.”

text.zh: a. 含有ECCN 1C350所列前体化学品、但浓度低于1C350.b至.d所示水平的混合物，受ECCN 1C395或1C995管制，并适用这些ECCN规定的许可要求。
text.en: a. Mixtures that contain precursor chemicals identified in ECCN 1C350, in concentrations that are below the levels indicated in 1C350.b through .d, are controlled by ECCN 1C395 or 1C995 and are subject to the licensing requirements specified in those ECCNs.

text.zh: b. 混合物中的受管制化学品如属于供个人使用、按零售方式包装的消费品正常成分，则本ECCN不要求许可证。此类消费品归为EAR99。但仍可能因EAR其他规定须取得许可证。
text.en: b. A license is not required under this ECCN for a mixture, when the controlled chemical in the mixture is a normal ingredient in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use. Such consumer goods are designated EAR99. However, a license may be required for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

text.en: a. Exclusion. No chemical may be added to the mixture (solution) for the sole purpose of circumventing the Export Administration Regulations;

text.zh: b. 重量百分比计算。计算化学混合物中各成分的重量百分比时，应计入全部成分，包括作为溶剂的成分。
text.en: b. Percent Weight Calculation. When calculating the percentage, by weight, of ingredients in a chemical mixture, include all ingredients of the mixture, including those that act as solvents.

text.zh: 3. 化合物。使用本ECCN 1C350所列任何化学品形成的化合物，可以NLR（无须许可证）方式运输，无须取得最终用途证明；但该化合物本身也列于本条目，或因EAR其他规定须取得许可证的除外。
text.en: 3. COMPOUNDS. Compounds created with any chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C350 may be shipped NLR (No License Required), without obtaining an End-Use Certificate, unless those compounds are also identified in this entry or require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

text.zh: 4. 测试试剂盒：含有少量本ECCN 1C350所列化学品的某些医疗、分析、诊断和食品测试试剂盒，不在本ECCN范围内，而受ECCN 1C395或1C995管制。（注意：这些试剂盒的替换试剂，如含有一种或多种1C350所列前体化学品，且浓度达到或超过1C350所示混合物管制水平，则受本ECCN 1C350管制。）
text.en: 4. TESTING KITS: Certain medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits containing small quantities of chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C350, are excluded from the scope of this ECCN and are controlled under ECCN 1C395 or 1C995. (Note that replacement reagents for such kits are controlled by this ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain one or more of the precursor chemicals identified in 1C350 in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.)

text.zh: 1. 就本条目而言，“混合物”定义为由两种或多种在正常储存条件下不相互反应的成分组成的固体、液体或气体产品。
text.en: 1. For purposes of this entry, a “mixture” is defined as a solid, liquid or gaseous product made up of two or more ingredients that do not react together under normal storage conditions.

text.zh: 2. 对氟化氢的本项管制范围（见受管制物项清单1C350.d.14）包括其液相、气相、水溶液及水合物。
text.en: 2. The scope of this control applicable to Hydrogen Fluoride (see 1C350.d.14 in the List of Items Controlled) includes its liquid, gaseous, and aqueous phases, and hydrates.

text.zh: 3. ECCN 1C350前体化学品按名称、化学文摘社（CAS）号和CWC附表（如适用）列示。结构式相同的前体化学品（如水合物、同位素标记形态或所有可能的立体异构体），均受ECCN 1C350管制，不论名称或CAS号为何。列示CAS号是为了辅助识别特定前体化学品或混合物是否受ECCN 1C350管制，不受命名方式影响。但CAS号不能在所有情况下作为唯一标识，因为所列前体化学品的某些形态具有不同CAS号，含有ECCN 1C350所列前体化学品的混合物也可能具有不同CAS号。
text.en: 3. Precursor chemicals in ECCN 1C350 are listed by name, Chemical Abstract Service (CAS) number and CWC Schedule (where applicable). Precursor chemicals of the same structural formula (e.g., hydrates, isotopically-labeled forms or all possible stereoisomers) are controlled by ECCN 1C350, regardless of name or CAS number. CAS numbers are shown to assist in identifying whether a particular precursor chemical or mixture is controlled under ECCN 1C350, irrespective of nomenclature. However, CAS numbers cannot be used as unique identifiers in all situations because some forms of the listed precursor chemical have different CAS numbers, and mixtures containing a precursor chemical listed in ECCN 1C350 may also have different CAS numbers.

text.zh: 1. 所有疫苗和‘免疫毒素’均排除在本条目范围之外。含有1C351.d管制生物毒素的某些医疗产品、诊断及食品测试试剂盒，也排除在本条目范围之外，但因CW原因受1C351.d.15或.d.16管制的毒素除外。排除在本条目范围之外的疫苗、‘免疫毒素’、某些医疗产品、诊断及食品测试试剂盒，受ECCN 1C991管制。
text.en: 1. All vaccines and 'immunotoxins' are excluded from the scope of this entry. Certain medical products and diagnostic and food testing kits that contain biological toxins controlled under 1C351.d, with the exception of toxins controlled for CW reasons under 1C351.d.15 or .d.16, are excluded from the scope of this entry. Vaccines, 'immunotoxins', certain medical products, and diagnostic and food testing kits excluded from the scope of this entry are controlled under ECCN 1C991.

text.zh: 2. 除1C351.c.12所述产ε毒素产气荚膜梭菌菌株外，其他产气荚膜梭菌菌株排除在本条目范围之外，因为它们可用作食品测试和质量控制的阳性对照培养物。
text.en: 2. Clostridium perfringens strains, other than the epsilon toxin-producing strains of Clostridium perfringens described in 1C351.c.12, are excluded from the scope of this entry, since they may be used as positive control cultures for food testing and quality control.

text.zh: 3. 除本ECCN 1C351其他处另有规定（如许可要求注1—3）外，本ECCN管制其受管制物项清单所列的所有生物剂和“毒素”，不论数量或减毒情况，包括美国农业部（USDA）动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）或美国卫生与公众服务部（HHS）疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）分别依据其《联邦法规》第9编第121部分和第42编第73部分规定，从特定生物剂或“毒素”清单中排除的少量或减毒菌株生物剂及“毒素”。
text.en: 3. Unless specified elsewhere in this ECCN 1C351 (e.g., in License Requirement Notes 1-3), this ECCN controls all biological agents and “toxins,” regardless of quantity or attenuation, that are identified in the List of Items Controlled for this ECCN, including small quantities or attenuated strains of select biological agents or “toxins” that are excluded from the lists of select biological agents or “toxins” by the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), or the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), in accordance with their regulations in 9 CFR part 121 and 42 CFR part 73, respectively.

text.zh: 4. 生物剂和病原体在以下形态下受本ECCN 1C351管制：病原体的分离活培养物，或从任何来源或材料中分离或提取的毒素制剂，包括故意接种或污染该生物剂的活体材料。病原体分离活培养物包括休眠形态或干燥制剂中的活培养物，不论其为天然、经增强还是经改造。
text.en: 4. Biological agents and pathogens are controlled under this ECCN 1C351 when they are an isolated live culture of a pathogen agent, or a preparation of a toxin agent that has been isolated or extracted from any source or material, including living material that has been deliberately inoculated or contaminated with the agent. text.zh: 1. 含本ECCN列明的遗传元件或遗传修饰生物体的疫苗受1C991管制。
text.en: 1. Vaccines that contain genetic elements or genetically modified organisms identified in this ECCN are controlled by ECCN 1C991.

text.zh: 2. 除本ECCN 1C353其他位置另有规定（例如许可要求注释1）外，受管制物项清单列明的全部生物因子和毒素的遗传元件或遗传修饰生物体均受本条目管制，不论数量或减毒程度；这包括按照美国农业部动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）7 CFR第331部分和9 CFR第121部分以及美国卫生与公众服务部疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）42 CFR第73部分，由APHIS或CDC从特定病原体清单中排除的特定生物因子或毒素减毒株的遗传元件或遗传修饰生物体。
text.en: 2. Unless specified elsewhere in this ECCN 1C353 (e.g., in License Requirement Note 1), this ECCN controls genetic elements or genetically modified organisms for all biological agents and “toxins,” regardless of quantity or attenuation, that are identified in the List of Items Controlled for this ECCN, including genetic elements or genetically modified organisms for attenuated strains of select biological agents or “toxins” that are excluded from the lists of select biological agents or “toxins” by the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture, or the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, in accordance with the APHIS regulations in 7 CFR part 331 and 9 CFR part 121 and the CDC regulations in 42 CFR part 73.

(2) See USML Category XIV for modified biological agents and biologically derived substances that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: a. 含有下列任何内容的任何遗传修饰生物体，或编码下列任何内容的任何遗传元件：
text.en: a. Any genetically modified organism that contains, or any genetic element that codes for, any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. ECCN 1C351.a、1C351.b或1C354.c管制的任何病毒所特有的任何单个或多个基因、单个或多个翻译产物；
text.en: a.1. Any gene, genes, translated product or translated products specific to any virus controlled by 1C351.a or .b or 1C354.c;

text.zh: a.2. ECCN 1C351.c或1C354.a管制的任何细菌，或1C351.e或1C354.b管制的任何真菌所特有的任何单个或多个基因，且：
text.en: a.2. Any gene or genes specific to any bacterium controlled by 1C351.c or 1C354.a, or any fungus controlled by 1C351.e or 1C354.b, and which;

text.zh: a.2.a. 其本身或通过其转录或翻译产物对人类、动物或植物健康构成重大危害；或
text.en: a.2.a. In itself or through its transcribed or translated products represents a significant hazard to human, animal or plant health; or

text.zh: a.2.b. 能够赋予或增强致病性；或
text.en: a.2.b. Could endow or enhance pathogenicity; or

text.zh: a.3. 1C351.d管制的任何毒素或其亚单位。
text.en: a.3. Any toxins, or their subunits, controlled by 1C351.d.

text.zh: 1. 遗传修饰生物体包括通过人为分子操作创建或改变核酸序列的生物体。
text.en: 1. Genetically modified organisms include organisms in which the nucleic acid sequences have been created or altered by deliberate molecular manipulation.

text.zh: 2. “遗传元件”包括但不限于染色体、基因组、质粒、转座子、载体，以及含有可回收核酸片段的灭活生物体，无论其经过或未经过遗传修饰，或全部或部分通过化学合成。就本ECCN 1C353而言，如果材料的灭活和制备旨在或已知可促进核酸的分离、纯化、扩增、检测或鉴定，则来自灭活生物体、病毒或样本的核酸视为“可回收”。
text.en: 2. “Genetic elements” include, inter alia, chromosomes, genomes, plasmids, transposons, vectors, and inactivated organisms containing recoverable nucleic acid fragments, whether genetically modified or unmodified, or chemically synthesized in whole or in part. For the purposes of this ECCN 1C353, nucleic acids from an inactivated organism, virus, or sample are considered to be 'recoverable' if the inactivation and preparation of the material is intended or known to facilitate isolation, purification, amplification, detection, or identification of nucleic acids.

text.zh: 3. 本ECCN不管制O26、O45、O103、O104、O111、O121、O145、O157血清群及其他产志贺毒素血清群的产志贺毒素大肠杆菌核酸序列，但编码志贺毒素或其亚单位的遗传元件除外。
text.en: 3. This ECCN does not control nucleic acid sequences of shiga toxin producing Escherichia coli of serogroups O26, O45, O103, O104, O111, O121, O145, O157, and other shiga toxin producing serogroups, other than those genetic elements coding for shiga toxin, or for its subunits.

text.zh: 4. “赋予或增强致病性”是指插入或整合一个或多个核酸序列可能使受体生物体获得或增强被用于故意导致疾病或死亡的能力。这可包括对以下方面的改变，但不限于：毒力、传播能力、稳定性、感染途径、宿主范围、繁殖能力、逃避或抑制宿主免疫的能力、对医疗应对措施的抵抗能力或可检测性。
text.en: 4. 'Endow or enhance pathogenicity' is defined as when the insertion or integration of the nucleic acid sequence or sequences is/are likely to enable or increase a recipient organism's ability to be used to deliberately cause disease or death. This might include alterations to, inter alia: virulence, transmissibility, stability, route of infection, host range, reproducibility, ability to evade or suppress host immunity, resistance to medical countermeasures, or detectability.

text.zh: 1. 所有疫苗均排除在本ECCN范围之外。疫苗见ECCN 1C991。
text.en: 1. All vaccines are excluded from the scope of this ECCN. See ECCN 1C991 for vaccines.

text.zh: 2. 除本ECCN 1C354其他位置另有规定（例如许可要求注释1）外，本ECCN受管制物项清单列明的全部生物因子均受本条目管制，不论数量或减毒程度；这包括美国农业部动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）按照7 CFR第331部分规定，从植物保护和检疫（PPQ）特定病原体及“毒素”清单中排除的少量特定生物因子或其减毒株。
text.en: 2. Unless specified elsewhere in this ECCN 1C354 (e.g., in License Requirement Note 1), this ECCN controls all biological agents, regardless of quantity or attenuation, that are identified in the List of Items Controlled for this ECCN, including small quantities or attenuated strains of select biological agents that are excluded from the list of PPQ select agents and “toxins” by the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture, in accordance with their regulations in 7 CFR part 331.

text.zh: 相关管制：（1）美国农业部动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）对本ECCN管制的某些物项在美国境内的持有、使用和转移实行管制（见7 CFR 331.3(c)、9 CFR 121.3(c)和9 CFR 121.4(c)）。（2）受美国国务院国防贸易管制局出口许可管辖的修饰生物因子及生物衍生物质，见22 CFR第121部分第XIV(b)类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) The Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture, maintains controls on the possession, use, and transfer within the United States of certain items controlled by this ECCN (see 7 CFR 331.3(c), 9 CFR 121.3(c), and 9 CFR 121.4(c)). (2) See 22 CFR part 121, Category XIV(b), for modified biological agents and biologically derived substances that are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the U.S. Department of State, Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

text.zh: 1C355 未受ECCN 1C350管制且不“受ITAR管辖”的《禁止化学武器公约》（CWC）附表2和附表3化学品及化学品族（见22 CFR相关部分）（见受管制物项清单）。
text.en: 1C355 Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC) Schedule 2 and 3 chemicals and families of chemicals not controlled by ECCN 1C350 or “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts) (see List of Items Controlled).

text.zh: CW适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C355.a列明的CWC附表2化学品及混合物需要许可证。向CWC非缔约国出口1C355.b列明的CWC附表3化学品及混合物需要许可证，除非出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明。将1C355.b列明的CWC附表3化学品及混合物从一个CWC非缔约国再出口到任何其他CWC非缔约国需要许可证。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR第742.18节。）
text.en: CW applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required to export or reexport CWC Schedule 2 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.a to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR). A license is required to export CWC Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.b to States not Party to the CWC, unless an End Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter, prior to export. A license is required to reexport CWC Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.b from a State not Party to the CWC to any other State not Party to the CWC. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons.)

text.zh: AT适用于本条目全部物项。商业国家表不用于确定1C350中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C350管制物项，因AT原因须取得许可证。（有关适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的AT管制，见EAR第742部分；适用于这些国家的制裁，见EAR第746部分。）
text.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C350. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C350 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

text.zh: a. 含有ECCN 1C355列明的有毒化学品及前体化学品、且浓度低于1C355.a和.b所示管制水平的混合物，受ECCN 1C995管制，并适用该ECCN规定的许可要求。
text.en: a. Mixtures containing toxic and precursor chemicals identified in ECCN 1C355, in concentrations that are below the control levels indicated in 1C355.a and .b, are controlled by ECCN 1C995 and are subject to the license requirements specified in that ECCN.

text.zh: b. 含有本条目列明化学品的混合物，如果该受管制化学品是包装供零售以供个人使用或包装供个人使用的消费品的正常成分，则不受ECCN 1C355管制。此类消费品归为EAR99。
text.en: b. Mixtures containing chemicals identified in this entry are not controlled by ECCN 1C355 when the controlled chemical is a normal ingredient in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use or packaged for individual use. Such consumer goods are classified as EAR99.

text.zh: 受CW管制化学品的浓度计算：
text.en: Calculation of concentrations of CW-controlled chemicals:

text.zh: a. 排除。不得仅为规避《出口管理条例》而向混合物（溶液）中添加任何化学品；
text.en: a. Exclusion. No chemical may be added to the mixture (solution) for the sole purpose of circumventing the Export Administration Regulations;

text.zh: b. 重量百分比计算。计算化学混合物中各成分的重量百分比时，应计入全部成分，包括作为溶剂的成分。
text.en: b. Percent Weight Calculation. When calculating the percentage, by weight, of ingredients in a chemical mixture, include all ingredients of the mixture, including those that act as solvents.

text.zh: 2. 化合物：使用本ECCN 1C355列明的任何化学品制成的化合物可以NLR（无需许可证）方式装运，无需取得最终用途证明，除非这些化合物也列于本条目，或由于EAR其他位置所述原因需要许可证。
text.en: 2. COMPOUNDS: Compounds created with any chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C355 may be shipped NLR (No License Required), without obtaining an End-Use Certificate, unless those compounds are also identified in this entry or require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

text.zh: 就本条目而言，“混合物”定义为由两种或两种以上成分组成的固体、液体或气体产品，这些成分在正常储存条件下不相互反应。
text.en: For purposes of this entry, a “mixture” is defined as a solid, liquid or gaseous product made up of two or more ingredients that do not react together under normal storage conditions.

text.en: Related Controls: See also ECCNs 1C350 1C351, 1C395, and 1C995. See §§ 742.18 and 745.2 of the EAR for End-Use Certification requirements.

text.en: 1C355.a.2.e. does not control N,N-Dimethylaminoethanol and corresponding protonated salts (C.A.S. 108-01-0) or N,N-Diethylaminoethanol and corresponding protonated salts (C.A.S. 100-37-8).

text.zh: 1C395 不受ECCN 1C350管制的下列混合物和医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒（见受管制物项清单）。
text.en: 1C395 Mixtures and Medical, Analytical, Diagnostic, and Food Testing Kits Not Controlled by ECCN 1C350, as follows (See List of Items Controlled).
Reason for Control: CB, CW, AT

text.zh: 管制：CB适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定1C395中因CB原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C395.a管制的混合物以及1C395.b管制的检测试剂盒，因CB原因需要许可证。
text.en: Control(s): CB applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CB reasons in 1C395. A license is required, for CB reasons, to export or reexport mixtures controlled by 1C395.a and test kits controlled by 1C395.b to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR).

text.zh: CW适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）进行下列活动，因CW原因需要许可证：（1）出口和再出口1C395.a管制的混合物；（2）出口和再出口1C395.b管制、且含有ECCN 1C350管制的CWC附表2化学品的检测试剂盒；（3）出口1C395.b管制、且含有ECCN 1C350管制的CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒，但如果出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明，则出口含有CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒不因CW原因需要许可证；以及（4）从CWC非缔约国再出口1C395.b管制且含有CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR第742.18节。）
text.en: CW applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required for CW reasons, as follows, to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR): (1) Exports and reexports of mixtures controlled by 1C395.a, (2) exports and reexports of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 2 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350, (3) exports of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 3 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350, except that a license is not required, for CW reasons, to export test kits containing CWC Schedule 3 chemicals if an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter prior to export, and (4) reexports from States not Party to the CWC of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 3 chemicals. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons.)

text.zh: AT适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定1C395中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补编1国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C395管制的物项，因AT原因需要许可证。（适用于伊朗、朝鲜、苏丹和叙利亚的AT管制补充信息见EAR第742部分。适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的制裁补充信息见EAR第746部分。）
text.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C395. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C395 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, Sudan, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

text.zh: 1. 1C395.b不管制含有ECCN 1C350.b或.c列明的前体化学品、且浓度低于1C350.b或.c所示混合物管制水平的混合物。此类混合物受1C395.a及1C995.a.1和a.2.a管制，除非其属于本ECCN许可要求注释2所述消费品。
text.en: 1. 1C395.b does not control mixtures that contain precursor chemicals identified in ECCN 1C350.b or .c in concentrations below the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.b or .c. 1C395.a and 1C995.a.1 and a.2.a control such mixtures, unless they are consumer goods, as described in License Requirements Note 2 of this ECCN.

text.zh: 2. 如果受管制化学品是包装供零售以供个人使用的消费品的正常成分，则本ECCN不管制该混合物。此类消费品归为EAR99。
text.en: 2. This ECCN does not control mixtures when the controlled chemicals are normal ingredients in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use. Such consumer goods are classified as EAR99.

text.zh: 基于清单的许可证例外（所有许可证例外的说明见第740部分）
text.en: List Based License Exceptions (See Part 740 for a description of all license exceptions)

text.zh: 相关管制：1. ECCN 1C350管制含有ECCN 1C350.b列明的任何单一CWC附表2化学品、且其重量浓度为30%或以上的混合物；ECCN 1C995管制该浓度为10%或以下的此类混合物。2. ECCN 1C995管制含有ECCN 1C350.d所列前体化学品的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关定义段）。ECCN 1C350管制1C350.b、.c或.d所列任何单一化学品的重量超过300克的任何此类试剂盒。
text.en: Related Controls: 1. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing 30 percent or higher concentrations, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b; ECCN 1C995 controls such mixtures containing concentrations of 10 percent or less. 2. ECCN 1C995 controls “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Definitions paragraph of this ECCN) that contain precursor chemicals listed in ECCN 1C350.d. ECCN 1C350 controls any such kits in which the amount of any single chemical listed in 1C350.b, .c, or .d exceeds 300 grams by weight.

text.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”是具有规定组成、专门为医疗、分析、诊断或公共卫生目的开发、包装和销售的预包装材料。对于1C395.b所述医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒的替换试剂，如果其含有ECCN 1C350列明的至少一种前体化学品，且浓度等于或高于1C350.b或.c所示混合物管制水平，则受ECCN 1C350管制。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” are pre-packaged materials of defined composition that are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for medical, analytical, diagnostic, or public health purposes. Replacement reagents for medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits described in 1C395.b are controlled by ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain at least one of the precursor chemicals identified in that ECCN in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.b. or .c.

text.zh: 物项：a. 含有ECCN 1C350.b列明的任何单一CWC附表2化学品，且该化学品占混合物重量超过10%但低于30%的混合物（含有这些化学品的其他混合物的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段注释1）。
text.en: Items: a. Mixtures containing more than 10 percent, but less than 30 percent, by weight of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Note 1 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.).

text.zh: b. 含有ECCN 1C350.b或.c管制的CWC附表2或附表3化学品、且每种化学品含量不超过300克的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关定义）。（含有这些化学品及其他受管制化学品的其他此类检测试剂盒的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段注释2。）
text.en: b. “Medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Definitions for this ECCN) that contain CWC Schedule 2 or 3 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350.b or .c in an amount not exceeding 300 grams per chemical. (For controls on other such test kits containing these and other controlled chemicals, see Note 2 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.)

(2) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(b), for modified biological agents and biologically derived substances that are subject to the ITAR. (3) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(g), for ITAR controls on antibodies, recombinant protective antigens, polynucleotides, biopolymers or biocatalysts (including the expression vectors, viruses, plasmids, or cultures of specific cells used to produce them) that are “specially designed” for use with articles controlled under USML Category XIV(f). (4) See ECCN 0A919 for “military commodities” located and produced outside the United States that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

text.en: ECCN 1C607.a. does not control the following: formulations containing 1% or less of CN or CS; individually packaged tear gases or riot control agents for personal self-defense purposes that are controlled by ECCN 1A984; or active constituent chemicals, and combinations thereof, identified and packaged for food production or medical purposes.

text.en: b. “Biopolymers,” not controlled by USML Category XIV(g) “specially designed” or processed for the detection or identification of chemical warfare agents specified by USML Category XIV(a), and the cultures of specific cells used to produce them.

text.zh: c. 不受USML第XIV(g)类管制、为消除或降解USML第XIV(a)类管制的化学战剂而“专门设计”的下列“生物催化剂”及其生物系统：
text.en: c. “Biocatalysts,” and biological systems therefor, not controlled by USML Category XIV(g) “specially designed” for the decontamination or degradation of chemical warfare agents controlled in USML Category XIV (a), as follows:

text.en: c.1. “Biocatalysts” “specially designed” for the decontamination or degradation of chemical warfare agents controlled in USML Category XIV(a) resulting from directed laboratory selection or genetic manipulation of biological systems;

text.zh: c.2. 含有专用于生产1C607.c.1所列“生物催化剂”的遗传信息的下列生物系统：
text.en: c.2. Biological systems containing the genetic information specific to the production of “biocatalysts” specified by 1C607.c.1, as follows:

text.en: The cultures of cells and biological systems are exclusive and these sub-items do not apply to cells or biological systems for civil purposes, such as agricultural, pharmaceutical, medical, veterinary, environmental, waste management, or in the food industry.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 含有USML第V(c)(6)、V(h)或V(i)子项所管制材料的装置或装药不受EAR管制；含有此类材料的装置由USML管制。(2) 本条目中的装置和装药，如含有USML第V类管制的材料（浆状物除外），且能够在不破坏装置或装药的情况下轻易提取这些材料，则由USML第III、IV或V类管制。(3) 另见ECCN 1A006、1A007、1A008、1C011、1C111、1C239和1C992列举的炸药及其他物项。(4) 外国制造的“军用商品”如含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受控成分，见ECCN 0A919。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) The EAR does not control devices or charges containing materials controlled by USML subparagraphs V(c)(6), V(h), or V(i). The USML controls devices containing such materials. (2) The USML in Categories III, IV, or V controls devices and charges in this entry if they contain materials controlled by Category V (other than slurries) and such materials can be easily extracted without destroying the device or charge. (3) See also explosives and other items enumerated in ECCNs 1A006, 1A007, 1A008, 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C992. (4) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) 就本条目而言，“受控材料”指ECCN 1C011、1C111、1C239、1C608或USML第V类列举的受控含能材料。(2) 就本条目而言，“推进剂”指通过化学反应以受控速率产生大量热气体、从而做机械功的物质或混合物。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) For purposes of this entry, the term 'controlled materials' means controlled energetic materials enumerated in ECCNs 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, 1C608, or USML Category V. (2) For the purposes of this entry, the term 'propellants' means substances or mixtures that react chemically to produce large volumes of hot gases at controlled rates to perform mechanical work.

text.zh: 物项：a. 含有氮含量大于12.6%的硝化纤维素，且呈下列任一形态的“单基”“双基”和“三基”“推进剂”：
text.en: Items: a. 'Single base', 'double base', and 'triple base' 'propellants' having nitrocellulose with nitrogen content greater than 12.6% in the form of either:

text.zh: a.2. 直径大于0.10英寸的药粒。
text.en: a.2. Grains with diameter greater than 0.10 inches.

text.zh: 本条目不管制用于霰弹枪弹、小型武器枪弹或步枪弹的“推进剂”药粒。
text.en: This entry does not control 'propellant' grains used in shotgun shells, small arms cartridges, or rifle cartridges.

text.zh: 1. “片材”指制造成适于进一步加工的片状“推进剂”。
text.en: 1. 'Sheetstock' is 'propellant' that has been manufactured in the form of a sheet suitable for further processing.

text.zh: 2. “卷材”指先制成片状、通常切割成所需宽度，再像地毯一样卷起的“推进剂”。
text.en: 2. A 'carpet roll' is 'propellant' that has been manufactured as a sheet, often cut to a desired width, and subsequently rolled up (like a carpet).

text.zh: 3. “单基”指主要由硝化纤维素组成的“推进剂”。
text.en: 3. 'Single base' is 'propellant' which consists mostly of nitrocellulose.

text.zh: 4. “双基”“推进剂”主要由硝化纤维素和硝化甘油组成。
text.en: 4. 'Double base' 'propellant' consist mostly of nitrocellulose and nitroglycerine.

text.zh: 5. “三基”主要由硝化纤维素、硝化甘油和硝基胍组成。这类“推进剂”还含有树脂或稳定剂等其他材料，可包括碳、盐类、燃速调节剂、硝基二苯胺、蜡、聚乙二醇（PEG）和聚乙二醇己二酸酯（PGA）。
text.en: 5. 'Triple base' consists mostly of nitrocellulose, nitroglycerine, and nitroguanidine. Such 'propellants' contain other materials, such as resins or stabilizers, that could include carbon, salts, burn rate modifiers, nitrodiphenylamine, wax, polyethylene glycol (PEG), polyglycol adipate (PGA).

text.zh: b. 每米含有大于0.064 kg（每英尺300格令）但不超过0.1 kg（每英尺470格令）“受控材料”的导爆管。
text.en: b. Shock tubes containing greater than 0.064 kg per meter (300 grains per foot), but not more than 0.1 kg per meter (470 grains per foot) of 'controlled materials.'

text.zh: c. 含有大于0.70 kg但不超过1.0 kg“受控材料”的药筒动力装置。
text.en: c. Cartridge power devices containing greater than 0.70 kg, but not more than 1.0 kg of 'controlled materials.'

text.zh: d. 含有大于0.01 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的雷管（电雷管或非电雷管）及为其“专门设计”的组件。
text.en: d. Detonators (electric or nonelectric) and “specially designed” assemblies therefor containing greater than 0.01 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: e. 不受USML第III或IV类管制，且含有大于0.01 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的点火器。
text.en: e. Igniters not controlled by USML Categories III or IV that contain greater than 0.01 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: f. 含有大于0.015 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的油井药筒。
text.en: f. Oil well cartridges containing greater than 0.015 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: g. 含有大于1.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的商用浇铸或压制传爆药柱。
text.en: g. Commercial cast or pressed boosters containing greater than 1.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: h. 含有大于10 kg且按重量计不超过35%的USML“受控材料”的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物。
text.en: h. Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing greater than 10 kg and less than or equal to thirty-five percent by weight of USML 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: j. 为商业用途（例如剧院舞台、电影特效和烟花表演）而“专门设计”，且含有大于3.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的“烟火”装置。
text.en: j. “Pyrotechnic” devices “specially designed” for commercial purposes (e.g., theatrical stages, motion picture special effects, and fireworks displays), and containing greater than 3.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: k. 为商业应用而“专门设计”、不受上述1C608.c至.g管制，且含有大于1.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的其他商用爆炸装置或装药。
text.en: k. Other commercial explosive devices or charges “specially designed” for commercial applications, not controlled by 1C608.c through .g above, containing greater than 1.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

text.zh: l. 丙烯亚胺（2-甲基氮丙啶）（C.A.S. #75-55-8）。

text.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“免疫毒素”指与毒素连接的单克隆抗体，旨在杀灭特定靶细胞，同时保持邻近细胞完整。就本条目而言，“医疗产品”是同时符合下列条件的产品：(1) 采用药物配方，设计用于试验以及对人或动物给药以治疗病症；(2) 已预先包装，供作为临床或医疗产品分销；以及(3) 已获美国食品药品监督管理局批准，作为临床或医疗产品销售，或作为“研究性新药”（IND）使用（见21 CFR第312部分）。就本条目而言，“诊断及食品检测试剂盒”指为诊断或公共卫生用途而专门开发、包装和销售的试剂盒。以其他任何形式提供（包括散装运输）或用于其他任何最终用途的生物毒素，均由ECCN 1C351管制。就本条目而言，“疫苗”定义为采用药物配方的药用或兽用产品，已获美国食品药品监督管理局或美国农业部批准作为医疗或兽用产品销售或用于临床试验，旨在刺激人或动物产生保护性免疫反应，以预防接种对象患病。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, 'immunotoxins' are monoclonal antibodies linked to a toxin with the intention of destroying a specific target cell while leaving adjacent cells intact. For the purpose of this entry, 'medical products' are: (1) Pharmaceutical formulations designed for testing and human (or veterinary) administration in the treatment of medical conditions; (2) prepackaged for distribution as clinical or medical products; and (3) approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration either to be marketed as clinical or medical products or for use as an “Investigational New Drug” (IND) (see 21 CFR part 312). For the purpose of this entry, 'diagnostic and food testing kits' are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for diagnostic or public health purposes. Biological toxins in any other configuration, including bulk shipments, or for any other end-uses are controlled by ECCN 1C351. For the purpose of this entry, 'vaccine' is defined as a medicinal (or veterinary) product in a pharmaceutical formulation, approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or the U.S. Department of Agriculture to be marketed as a medical (or veterinary) product or for use in clinical trials, that is intended to stimulate a protective immunological response in humans or animals in order to prevent disease in those to whom or to which it is administered.

text.en: Related Controls: (1) Commercial charges and devices “subject to the EAR,” contain energetic materials described on the USML that exceed the quantities noted or that are not covered by this entry are controlled under ECCN 1C608. (2) Nitrogen trifluoride when not in a gaseous state is controlled under ECCN 1C608.

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) 本条目ECCN 1C992管制的物项为不受ECCN 1C608管制且不“受ITAR管辖”的材料。(2) 就本条目而言，“受控材料”指受控含能材料（见ECCN 1C011、1C111、1C239和1C608；另见22 CFR 121.1第V类）。(3) USML所述单种含能材料，即使与其他材料配制在一起，只要未被加入爆炸装置或装药，仍“受ITAR管辖”。(4) 含有超过35%的USML所述含能材料的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物“受ITAR管辖”。(5) 就本条目而言，确定商用爆炸装置和装药中受控材料总质量时，不计入其中铝粉、高氯酸钾及USML注释（见22 CFR 121.12）所列任何物质（例如苦味酸铵、黑火药等）的质量。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) Items controlled by this entry ECCN 1C992 are those materials not controlled by ECCN 1C608 and not “subject to the ITAR.” (2) For purposes of this entry, the term “controlled materials” means controlled energetic materials (see ECCNs 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C608; see also 22 CFR 121.1, Category V). (3) The individual energetic materials described on the USML, even when compounded with other materials, remain “subject to the ITAR” when not incorporated into explosive devices or charges. (4) Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing greater than 35% of energetic materials described on the USML are “subject to the ITAR.” (5) For purposes of this entry, the mass of aluminum powder, potassium perchlorate, and any of the substances listed in the note to the USML (see 22 CFR 121.12) (such as ammonium pictrate, black powder, etc.) contained in commercial explosive devices and in the charges are omitted when determining the total mass of controlled material.

text.zh: a. 为油井作业而“专门设计”、采用沿单一轴线起作用的单个装药、起爆后形成孔洞，且符合下列条件的聚能装药：
text.en: a. Shaped charges “specially designed” for oil well operations, utilizing one charge functioning along a single axis, that upon detonation produce a hole, and

text.zh: a.1. 含有任意配方的受控材料；
text.en: a.1. Contain any formulation of controlled materials;

text.zh: a.2. 仅具有形状均匀、顶角不超过90度的锥形药型罩；
text.en: a.2. Have only a uniform shaped conical liner with an included angle of 90 degrees or less;

text.zh: a.3. 含有大于0.010 kg但小于等于0.090 kg的受控材料；以及
text.en: a.3. Contain more than 0.010 kg but less than or equal to 0.090 kg of controlled materials; and
a.4. Have a diameter not exceeding 4.5 inches;

text.zh: b. 为油井作业而“专门设计”，且含有小于等于0.010 kg受控材料的聚能装药；
text.en: b. Shaped charges “specially designed” for oil well operations containing less than or equal to 0.010 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: c. 每米含有小于等于0.064 kg（每英尺300格令）受控材料的导爆索或导爆管；
text.en: c. Detonation cord or shock tubes containing less than or equal to 0.064 kg per meter (300 grains per foot) of controlled materials;

text.zh: d. 爆燃材料中含有小于等于0.70 kg受控材料的药筒动力装置；
text.en: d. Cartridge power devices, that contain less than or equal to 0.70 kg of controlled materials in the deflagration material;

text.zh: e. 含有小于等于0.01 kg受控材料的雷管（电雷管或非电雷管）及其组件；
text.en: e. Detonators (electric or nonelectric) and assemblies thereof, that contain less than or equal to 0.01 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: f. 含有小于等于0.01 kg受控材料的点火器；
text.en: f. Igniters, that contain less than or equal to 0.01 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: g. 含有小于等于0.015 kg受控含能材料的油井药筒；
text.en: g. Oil well cartridges, that contain less than or equal to 0.015 kg of controlled energetic materials;

text.zh: h. 含有小于等于1.0 kg受控材料的商用浇铸或压制传爆药柱；
text.en: h. Commercial cast or pressed boosters containing less than or equal to 1.0 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: i. 含有小于等于10.0 kg且按重量计小于等于35%的USML所述材料的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物；
text.en: i. Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing less than or equal to 10.0 kg and less than or equal to thirty-five percent by weight of materials described on the USML;

text.zh: j. 含有小于等于3.5 kg受控材料的切割器和切断工具；
text.en: j. Cutters and severing tools containing less than or equal to 3.5 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: k. 专为商业用途（例如剧院舞台、电影特效和烟花表演）设计，且含有小于等于3.0 kg受控材料的烟火装置；或
text.en: k. Pyrotechnic devices when designed exclusively for commercial purposes (e.g., theatrical stages, motion picture special effects, and fireworks displays) and containing less than or equal to 3.0 kg of controlled materials; or

text.zh: l. 不受1C992.a至.k管制，且含有小于等于1.0 kg受控材料的其他商用爆炸装置和装药。
text.en: l. Other commercial explosive devices and charges not controlled by 1C992.a through .k containing less than or equal to 1.0 kg of controlled materials.

text.zh: 1C992.l包括汽车安全装置；灭火系统；铆钉枪药筒；用于农业、油气作业、体育用品、商业采矿或公共工程的爆炸装药；以及用于组装商用爆炸装置的延期管。
text.en: 1C992.l includes automotive safety devices; extinguishing systems; cartridges for riveting guns; explosive charges for agricultural, oil and gas operations, sporting goods, commercial mining, or public works purposes; and delay tubes used in the assembly of commercial explosive devices.
m. Nitrogen trifluoride (NF_{3}) in a gaseous state.

text.en: 1. This ECCN does not control mixtures containing less than 0.5% of any single toxic or precursor chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.b, .c, or .d or ECCN 1C355 as unavoidable by-products or impurities. Such mixtures are classified as EAR99.

text.zh: 2. 1C995.c不管制含有1C350.d列明的前体化学品、且浓度低于1C350.d规定的混合物浓度水平的混合物。此类混合物由1C995.a.2.b管制，但本ECCN许可证要求注释3所述的消费品除外。
text.en: 2. 1C995.c does not control mixtures that contain precursor chemicals identified in 1C350.d in concentrations below the levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.d. 1C995.a.2.b controls such mixtures, unless they are consumer goods as described in License Requirements Note 3 of this ECCN.

text.zh: 3. 当受控化学品为供个人使用、以零售形式包装的消费品中的正常成分时，本ECCN不管制此类混合物。此类消费品归类为EAR99。
text.en: 3. This ECCN does not control mixtures when the controlled chemicals are normal ingredients in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use. Such consumer goods are classified as EAR99.

ECCN 1C350管制含有ECCN 1C350.c或.d列明的化学品、且浓度超过1C995.a.2规定水平的混合物。3. ECCN 1C355管制含有ECCN 1C355列明的化学品、且浓度超过1C995.b规定水平的混合物。4. ECCN 1C395管制含有1C350.b或.c列明的CWC附表2或附表3化学品的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关管制段落）。ECCN 1C350管制其中任何一种1C350.b、.c或.d列明的化学品重量超过300克的此类检测试剂盒。
text.en: Related Controls: 1. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing 30 percent or higher concentrations of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b. ECCN 1C395 controls mixtures containing concentrations of more than 10 percent, but less than 30 percent, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b. 2. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing chemicals identified in ECCN 1C350.c or .d that exceed the concentration levels indicated in 1C995.a.2. 3. ECCN 1C355 controls mixtures containing chemicals identified in ECCN 1C355 that exceed the concentration levels indicated in 1C995.b. 4. ECCN 1C395 controls “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN) that contain CWC Schedule 2 or 3 chemicals listed in 1C350.b or .c. ECCN 1C350 controls any such testing kits in which the amount of any single chemical listed in 1C350.b, .c., or .d exceeds 300 grams by weight.

text.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”是指为医疗、分析、诊断或公共卫生目的专门开发、包装和销售，且组成确定的预包装材料。1C995.c所述医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒的替换试剂，如果含有ECCN 1C350列明的至少一种前体化学品，且浓度大于等于1C350.d规定的混合物管制水平，则由ECCN 1C350管制。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” are pre-packaged materials of defined composition that are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for medical, analytical, diagnostic, or public health purposes. Replacement reagents for medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits described in 1C995.c are controlled by ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain at least one of the precursor chemicals identified in that ECCN in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.d.

text.en: Items: a. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of precursor chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350 (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Notes 1 and 2 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.):

text.zh: a.2. 含有以下化学品、且其重量百分比小于30%的混合物：
text.en: a.2. Mixtures containing less than 30 percent, by weight, of:

text.zh: a.2.a. 任何一种ECCN 1C350.c管制的CWC附表3化学品；或
text.en: a.2.a. Any single CWC Schedule 3 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.c; or

text.zh: a.2.b. 任何一种ECCN 1C350.d管制的前体化学品。
text.en: a.2.b. Any single precursor chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.d.

text.en: b. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of toxic or precursor chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C355 (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Note 3 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.):

text.zh: b.1. 含有以下浓度的ECCN 1C355.a管制的CWC附表2化学品的混合物：
text.en: b.1. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of CWC Schedule 2 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C355.a:

text.zh: b.1.a. 含有任何一种ECCN 1C355.a.1管制的CWC附表2化学品、且其重量百分比小于等于1%的混合物（即含有全氟异丁烯（PFIB）的混合物）；或
text.en: b.1.a. Mixtures containing 1 percent or less, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C355.a.1 (i.e., mixtures containing PFIB); or

text.zh: b.1.b. 含有任何一种1C355.a.2管制的CWC附表2化学品、且其重量百分比小于等于10%的混合物；
text.en: b.1.b. Mixtures containing 10 percent or less, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical controlled by 1C355.a.2;
